verdict.rationale: Linear's evidence covers customer requests, captured through integrations like Slack, Intercom and Front and turned into issues, but nothing describes an embeddable feedback widget or ways to change its label and colors. A feedback-intake tool could plausibly ship a branded widget, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows no such capability.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can customize the feedback widget's label and colors to match my brand
